result.brief: 用长程关联高斯随机势的Gibbs测度解析刻画扩散反向过程，提出"物种化窗口"与score的泡沫结构，解释逐步去噪优于单步生成的原因。
result.reason: Theoretical statistical-physics analysis of diffusion reverse process and score structure; no video/multimodal world model or representation contribution, but offers conceptual insight into generative latent structure.
